blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Strong single-turn editing performance does not guarantee reliable multi-turn interaction: as edited outputs are repeatedly reused, small unintended changes can accumulate into severe visual drift. This long-term drift is often mitigated through training on multi-turn data or cross-turn rollouts, potentially altering pretrained priors, or through specialized inference-time mechanisms that are difficult to scale to foundation models. We introduce TailSteer, a final-stage training framework that improves multi-turn robustness while retaining the generative and editing capabilities acquired through earlier training. TailSteer follows a simple principle: keep early denoising dynamics close to those of the base model and concentrate preservation corrections near the trajectory tail, where fine-grained deviations can be suppressed. These corrections are learned from the editor's own on-policy denoising rollouts, using unchanged source content as a preservation reference without requiring curated ground-truth editing pairs. Experiments across the FLUX, SenseNova, and Qwen families show that TailSteer substantially reduces cumulative drift over 15-20 editing turns while largely preserving base-model performance on extensive text-to-image and single-image editing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that long-horizon editing robustness can be unlocked in foundation models after TailSteer, rather than by relearning their existing capabilities.
blocks.zh: 强的单回合编辑性能并不能保证可靠的多回合交互:由于编辑输出被反复重复使用,小的意外变化可以累积成严重的视觉漂移. 这种长期漂移往往通过对多回合数据的培训或交叉回合的推出来缓解,可能改变事先受过训练的前科,或者通过难以扩大模型基础的专门推断时间机制来缓解。 我们介绍了TailSteer,这是一个最后阶段的训练框架,可提高多回合的稳健性,同时保留通过早期训练获得的基因和编辑能力。 TailSteer遵循一个简单的原则: 保持早期去诺动力学接近基准模型的动力学,并集中在轨迹尾部附近进行保存修正,在轨迹尾端可以压制细纹偏差. 这些更正是从编辑本身的政策性解码推出中汲取的,使用不变的源内容作为保护参考,而不需要经过整理的地面真象编辑配对。 跨越FLUX,SenseNova,以及Quen家族的实验显示,TailSteer大幅降低了15-20编辑转弯后的累计漂移量,同时在广泛的文本到图像和单图像编辑基准上基本保持了基模性能. 这些结果表明,长视距编辑稳健性可以在TailSteer之后的基础模型中解锁,而不是通过重新学习其现有能力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large-scale generative models have substantially advanced instruction-based image editing, achieving increasingly strong instruction following, visual fidelity, and content preservation in single-turn editing ( OpenAI, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2025b ; Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ; Black Forest Labs, 2025b ; Google, 2025 ) . At the same time, image generation is increasingly embedded in interactive and conversational creative workflows. Recent systems, such as Nano Banana 2, ChatGPT Images, Reve, or Muse Image, allow users to repeatedly refine an image through natural-language feedback, visual references, and agentic interactions ( Google, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ; Reve, 2026 ; Meta, 2026 ) . This interaction paradigm better matches how visual content is actually created: rather than specifying a complete target at once, users progressively develop an idea through a sequence of edits.
blocks.zh: 大规模基因模型具有相当高级的基于教学的图像编辑,在单回合编辑中实现越来越强的教学、视觉忠诚和内容保存(OpenAI,2025a;OpenAI,2025b;黑森林实验室等人,2025年;黑森林实验室,2025b;谷歌,2025年). 同时,图像生成越来越多地嵌入互动和对话的创意工作流程中. 近期的系统,如Nano Banana 2, ChatGPT Images, Reve, 或Muse Image, 允许用户通过自然语言反馈,视觉参考,和代理互动来反复完善一个图像(Google, 2026;OpenAI, 2026;Reve, 2026;Meta, 2026). 这种交互范式更符合视觉内容的实际生成方式:用户与其同时指定一个完整的目标,不如通过编辑的顺序逐步发展一个想法.

blocks.en: However, applying one-shot editors to iterative editing introduces a critical challenge: small errors in each edit can accumulate across successive turns. In a multi-turn workflow, each edited output becomes the next input, causing unintended changes to be repeatedly inherited by subsequent generations. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , repeated editing can wash out fine textures, alter non-target object or facial details, distort background structures, and eventually produce visible artifacts. Thus, strong single-turn editing performance does not necessarily translate into robust long-horizon editing.
blocks.zh: 然而,应用一拍编辑器进行迭代编辑带来了严峻的挑战:每次编辑中的小错误可以累积到连续的转弯. 在多回合工作流程中,每个编辑过的输出都成为下一个输入,导致意外变化被后人反复继承. 如图1所示,重复编辑可以洗刷精细的纹理,改变非目标物体或面部细节,扭曲背景结构,并最终产生可见文物. 因此,强大的单回合编辑性能并不一定会转化为强大的长视距编辑.

blocks.en:
Existing approaches to improving multi-turn image editing can be broadly categorized into three families.
i) Adding auxiliary modules or constraints to a pretrained model, by introducing spatial guidance (e.g., masks), specially trained LoRA adapters, or frequency corrections ( Couairon et al., 2023 ; dx8152, 2026 ; Liao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . These mechanisms improve preservation by sacrificing or constraining part of the large-scale generative prior learned by the pretrained model, and are therefore often limited to a relatively narrow range of localized edit types.
ii) Refining the representation space to better support image editing. As reconstruction fidelity and generative capability are widely recognized as a latent-generative dilemma ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Dieleman, 2025 ) , Black Forest Labs specifically treats the VAE representation to obtain a more suitable editing space ( Black Forest Labs, 2025a ) , while other approaches bypass the VAE and perform pixel-diffusion ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . Although these designs effectively alleviate errors within a single editing turn, they still suffer from noticeable degradation across repeated edits.
iii) Maintaining explicit memory across edits within creative workflows, by caching latent states or previous visual context ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Dalal et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025a ) , or by leveraging reasoning models for agentic planning and iterative refinement in commercial generative systems ( Meta, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) . While these mechanisms help retain historical information across turns, they do not directly improve the underlying model itself. Consequently, long-horizon consistency remains bottlenecked by the base model’s own robustness under repeated editing, often with additional inference overhead.
blocks.zh:
改进多回合图像编辑的现有办法可大致分为三个家庭。
(一)在预训模型中添加辅助模块或约束,采用空间引导(如口罩),专门训练的LORA适配器,或频率校正(Couairon等人,2023年;dx8152,2026年;廖等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年). 这些机制通过牺牲或限制预先训练过的模型之前学到的部分大规模基因,改善了保存,因此往往局限于比较狭窄的局部编辑类型.
(二) 缩小代表空间,以更好地支持图像编辑。 由于重建忠心度和基因能力被广泛认为是潜在的-遗传性难题(姚等人,2025年;Dieleman,2025年),黑森林实验室专门对待VAE代表,以获得更合适的编辑空间(黑森林实验室,2025a年),而其他方法则绕过VAE进行像素扩散(Yu等人,2026年). 虽然这些设计在单一编辑回合内有效缓解了错误,但是在反复编辑的过程中仍然受到明显的退化.
(iii) 通过缓存潜伏状态或先前的视觉环境(Yu等人,2025年;Dalal等人,2025年;Kim等人,2025年a),或通过利用推理模型进行代理规划和商业基因系统的迭代完善(Meta,2026年;OpenAI,2026年)。 虽然这些机制有助于保留跨周期的历史信息,但它们并没有直接改进基本模式本身。 因此,由于基准模型本身的稳健性受到反复编辑,而且往往还有额外的推论费,因此长期的一致性仍然受到瓶颈。

blocks.en: Although these approaches can improve multi-turn consistency, they often require auxiliary modules, alternative representations, or dedicated models. We instead directly improve the foundation model, so that multi-turn robustness is built into the model. This will not introduce additional inference components and also remain complementary to existing agentic workflow-level solutions.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些方法可以提高多回合一致性,但往往需要辅助模块、替代性表述或专用模式。 相反,我们直接改进了基础模型,从而将多回合稳健性纳入模型。 这不会引入更多的推论部分,也仍然是对现有代理工作流程级解决方案的补充。

blocks.en:
To improve the existing model, we first analyze why drifting happens in image editing, by inspecting the denoising trajectory.
Prior studies show that diffusion sampling follows a coarse-to-fine progression: low-frequency structure is established early, whereas high-frequency details are mainly recovered near the trajectory tail ( Qian et al., 2024 ) . This is particularly relevant to multi-turn editing, where repeated edits progressively degrade high-frequency information ( Liao et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, because each inference state depends on preceding model predictions, prediction errors can propagate along the sampling trajectory ( Ning et al., 2023 ; Ning et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Fig. 2 reveals that low-frequency similarity is already high before the final steps, whereas higher-frequency similarity rises sharply near the tail. Meanwhile, preservation error in unchanged regions continues to decrease but remains nonzero at the endpoint. These observations motivate refining the trajectory tail, where fine-grained details are finalized and residual preservation errors remain correctable.
blocks.zh:
为了改进现有的模型,我们首先分析为什么在图像编辑中发生漂移,通过检查去诺的轨迹.
先前的研究表明,扩散取样遵循粗到细的进展:低频结构是早期确定的,而高频细节主要在轨迹尾部附近回收(Qian等人,2024年)。 这与多回合编辑特别相关,重复编辑逐渐降解高频信息(廖等人,2026年). 此外,由于每个推论状态都取决于先前的模型预测,预测错误可以沿着取样轨迹传播(Ning等人,2023年;Ning等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年)。 图2显示,在最后步骤之前,低频相似度已经很高,而高频相似度则在尾部附近急剧上升. 与此同时,未改变区域保存错误继续减少,但终点为零。 这些观测结果促使对轨迹尾部进行精细化,最终确定细细的细节,剩余保存错误仍然可以纠正。

blocks.en: Based on this insight, we introduce TailSteer , a final-stage training framework that improves multi-turn robustness by steering only the trajectory tail. Rather than broadly reshaping the foundation model’s learned prior, TailSteer keeps early denoising dynamics close to those of the base model while progressively steering later denoising states toward a preservation-aware endpoint . To address the trajectory-level train-test gap, TailSteer learns from states reached through its own on-policy denoising rollouts, using unchanged source content as a preservation reference without curating ground-truth editing pairs. This targeted steering improves long-horizon robustness while retaining the foundation model’s learned priors.
blocks.zh: 基于这种洞察力,我们引入了TailSteer——一个最后阶段的训练框架,它只通过引导轨迹尾翼来提高多回合的稳健性. TailSteer不但没有大致重塑基础模型之前学到的知识,而是将早期的去诺动力学与基础模型的去诺动力学相近,同时逐渐将后来的去诺状态引导到保存意识的终点。 为了解决轨迹水平的火车测试差距,TailSteer从通过其自身政策解密推出所达到的州学习,使用不变的源内容作为保存参考,而不处理地面真实编辑对。 这种有针对性的指导提高了长视野的稳健性,同时保留了基础模型的以往经验。

blocks.en:
TailSteer’s tail-focused design offers three practical advantages.
First, TailSteer improves long-horizon editing robustness while largely preserving the generative and editing capabilities acquired through earlier training. Extensive evaluations on text-to-image generation and single-turn editing benchmarks show performance close to the foundation models, alongside substantial reductions in cumulative drift.
Second, TailSteer generalizes across model families and input settings by operating directly on denoising trajectories, without relying on a particular latent representation, attention mechanism, or model architecture. We validate this generality across FLUX ( Black Forest Labs, 2026 ) , SenseNova ( Diao et al., 2026a ) , and Qwen ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) backbones, including multi-image compositing and pose-guided editing.
Finally, TailSteer constructs preservation supervision from source images and the base model’s own rollouts, without requiring curated ground-truth editing pairs or cross-turn training data. Our scaling experiments further show that larger and more diverse rollout datasets can improve drift resistance while retaining the base model’s editing capabilities.
blocks.zh:
泰尔施泰尔的尾部聚焦设计提供了三个实际优势.
首先,TailSteer改进了长视距编辑稳健性,同时在很大程度上保留了通过早期培训获得的基因和编辑能力. 对文本到图像生成和单回合编辑基准的广泛评价显示,业绩接近基础模型,同时累积漂移量大幅减少。
第二,TailSteer通过直接使用去诺化的轨迹,而不依赖特定的潜伏代表、注意力机制或模型架构,在模型家庭和输入设置中进行概括。 我们在FLUX(黑森林实验室,2026年),SenseNova(Diao等人,2026a年),以及Quen(Quen Team,2026年)骨干之间验证这种概括性,包括多图像堆肥和姿势引导编辑.
最后,TailSteer从原始图像和基准模型本身的推出中构筑了保存监督,而不需要经过整理的地面实况编辑配对或交叉转弯培训数据。 我们的缩放实验进一步表明,更大的和更加多样化的推出数据集可以提高漂流阻力,同时保留基准模型的编辑能力。

blocks.en:
Our contributions are three-fold:
(1) We identify the denoising trajectory tail as a key intervention point for multi-turn editing, where fine-grained details are finalized while residual preservation errors remain correctable without broadly altering earlier dynamics.
(2) We introduce TailSteer , a final-stage training framework that learns from the model’s own on-policy rollouts, unlocking multi-turn robustness through trajectory-tail steering while largely preserving the base model’s learned priors.
(3) We introduce Add & Preserve to separately evaluate cumulative drift and edit completion, alongside extensive evaluations on text-to-image generation, single-turn editing, and general multi-turn benchmarks. Results across FLUX, SenseNova, and Qwen demonstrate substantially enhanced model-native long-horizon preservation while largely retaining original capabilities, with preservation performance rivaling or even surpassing GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst (via direct API calls).
blocks.zh:
我们的贡献有三个方面:
(1) 我们确定,去Noing轨迹尾巴是多轮编辑的关键干预点,在多轮编辑中最终确定精细细节,而剩余保存错误仍然可以纠正,而不会大致改变早先的动态。
(2) 我们引入了TailSteer,这是一个最后阶段的培训框架,它从模型本身的政策推出中学习,通过轨迹-尾翼方向解锁了多回合的稳健性,同时在很大程度上保留了基础模型所学到的前科。
(3)我们引入了Add & Preserve来单独评价累积漂移和编辑完成情况,同时对文本到图像生成,单回合编辑和一般多回合基准进行了广泛的评价. FLUX、SenseNova和Quen三地的成果显示,模型本土长视距保护得到大幅加强,同时基本上保留原始能力,保存性能与GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst(通过直接API调用)相竞争,甚至超过GPT-Image-2.5。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Multi-turn degradation has also been observed in LLMs ( Laban et al., 2026 ) , despite their growing success in agentic workflows. For image generation, however, repeatedly reusing generated outputs can compound visual errors, making long-horizon editing robustness a critical bottleneck for agentic creation. Existing methods address this limitation from several directions.
blocks.zh: 在LLMs(Laban等人,2026年)中也观察到了多轮降解,尽管它们在代理工作流程中不断取得成功。 然而,对于图像生成来说,反复重用生成的输出可能会使视觉错误复杂化,使得长视线编辑稳健性成为代理生成的关键瓶颈. 现有方法从几个方面解决这一局限性。

blocks.en: Prior work has explored the trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and generative learnability in latent representations, motivating improved representation designs ( Dieleman, 2025 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Black Forest Labs, 2025a ) . For iterative editing, other approaches mitigate accumulated reconstruction errors by reusing latent states across turns or improving stability under repeated encoding and decoding ( Joseph et al., 2024 ; Almog et al., 2025 ) . Alternatively, pixel-space generative models bypass the VAE bottleneck altogether ( Li and He, 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Diao et al., 2026b ) . These approaches address representation-level limitations, whereas TailSteer improves long-horizon preservation by refining existing models’ denoising dynamics.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作探讨了重建忠贞与潜在表述中可遗传性学习之间的权衡,推动改进表述设计(Dieleman,2025年;Yao等人,2025年;黑森林实验室,2025年a)。 关于迭代编辑,其他方法通过重复使用跨转弯的潜在状态或通过重复编码和解码提高稳定性来减少累积的重建错误(Joseph等人,2024年;Almog等人,2025年)。 或者,像素-空间基因模型完全绕过VAE瓶颈(Li and He, 2026;Yu等人, 2026;Diao等人, 2026b)。 这些方法解决了代表性方面的限制,而TailSteer则通过改进现有模型的去名动态改进了长视野的保存。

blocks.en: Prior work improves preservation through mask-guided constraints that localize edits ( Avrahami et al., 2022 ; Couairon et al., 2023 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , and frequency-based corrections that mitigate content degradation across turns ( Liao et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Beyond these constraints, training-free methods guide inversion and sampling to balance editing and preservation ( Zhou et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2025b ) . While effective in specific settings, these specialized inference procedures may not readily generalize across foundation models and do not directly improve the underlying model’s robustness.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作通过使编辑本地化的蒙面制导限制(Avrahami等人,2022年;Couairon等人,2023年;Yin等人,2025年)和基于频率的校正改进了保存工作,这些校正减轻了跨转弯的内容退化(Liao等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年)。 除了这些限制之外,无培训方法指导反演和取样,以平衡编辑和保存(周等人,2025年;江等人,2026年;金等人,2025年b)。 这些专门推论程序虽然在具体情况下有效,但可能无法轻易地泛泛于各种基础模型,也无法直接提高基础模型的稳健性。

blocks.en: Prior work improves editing consistency through feature reuse and cross-turn memory ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025a ) . Long-horizon video generation similarly leverages context retrieval and test-time memory ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Dalal et al., 2025 ) . Yet long-horizon consistency remains bottlenecked by the underlying generator’s per-step robustness.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作通过特性再利用和交叉转动内存提高了编辑的一致性(Zhu等人,2025年;Kim等人,2025年a). 长视视频生成类似地利用了上下文检索和测试时间记忆(Yu等人,2025年;Dalal等人,2025年)。 然而,长期的一贯性仍然受到基本发电机每步稳健性的限制。

blocks.en: Prior work trains multi-turn editors using video-derived sequences or cross-turn reinforcement learning ( Qu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) , while others train consistency LoRAs ( dx8152, 2026 ) . In contrast, TailSteer unlocks base model’s multi-turn potential through trajectory-tail steering, without relearning editing behavior from cross-turn supervision.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作培训多回合编辑,使用视频衍生的序列或交叉回合强化学习(Qu等人,2026年;Huang等人,2026年),而其他人则培训一致性LORAS(dx8152,2026年). 相比之下,TailSteer通过轨迹-尾导解锁了基础模型的多回合潜力,而不从交叉回合监管中重新学习编辑行为.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: TailSteer follows a simple principle: preserve the base model’s early denoising dynamics while steering only its tail toward better preservation. We present the framework through three progressively connected parts. First, we construct preservation-aware supervision directly from the frozen editor’s own rollouts, forming a “data-free” training paradigm without manually curated ground-truth editing pairs. Second, we study a one-step terminal intervention with supervision applied only to the final sampling step, demonstrating that endpoint correction alone can reduce cumulative drift. Finally, we extend this single-step intervention to TailSteer , distributing preservation-oriented steering over multiple steps in the trajectory tail while retaining the original dynamics of the earlier steps.
blocks.zh: 泰尔施泰尔遵循一个简单的原则:保留基底模型早期的去诺动力学,同时只引导尾巴更好地保存. 我们通过三个逐步相连的部分介绍该框架。 首先,我们从冷冻编辑本身的推出中直接构建保护意识监督,形成一种 " 无数据 " 的培训模式,而无需手工整理地面实况编辑对。 第二,我们研究一种仅对最后取样步骤进行监督的单步终端干预,表明仅末点修正就可以减少累积漂移。 最后,我们把这种单步干预扩展到了TailSteer,在轨迹尾部的多个步骤上分配面向保护的引导,同时保留早先步骤的原始动态。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preservation-Aware Trajectory Endpoint
blocks.zh: 3.1 保存- 软件轨迹端点

blocks.en: To steer the trajectory tail, the first question is what the trajectory should be steered toward. This target should remain aligned with the model’s own editing trajectory while correcting only the unintended deviations accumulated during sampling. However, conventional manually curated source–target editing pairs are poorly suited to this purpose. Given the same source image and instruction, a generative editor may produce different yet valid outputs under different sampling seeds. For example, an instruction to add an apple may yield apples with different sizes, colors, or surface patterns. Our goal is not to force the model toward one particular edit realization, but to correct the rollout-induced errors while preserving the edit already chosen by the model.
blocks.zh: 为了引导轨迹尾部,第一个问题是,应引导轨迹走向何方。 这一指标应与模型本身的编辑轨迹保持一致,同时仅纠正取样过程中积累的意外偏差。 然而,传统的手工编译源-目标编辑对并不适合这一目的。 鉴于同一来源图像和指导,基因编辑器可在不同的采样种子下产生不同但有效的产出。 例如,添加苹果的指令可能会产生大小,颜色,或表面图案不同的苹果. 我们的目标不是强迫模型向某个特定的编辑实现,而是在保留模型已经选择的编辑的同时,纠正推出引起的错误.

blocks.en: Remarkably, the preservation target is already available in the source image: the content not requested to change. For example, when replacing an object in a local region, the surrounding subject and background should remain unchanged. Although modern editors exhibit strong instruction following to localize the requested edit, their denoising rollouts still introduce small deviations into such non-target content. These model-induced deviations therefore provide exactly the preservation errors that TailSteer aims to correct.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,在源图像中已存在保存目标:不要求更改的内容. 例如,在局部地区替换对象时,周围的主题和背景应当保持不变. 虽然现代编辑人员在对要求的编辑进行本地化之后表现出强烈的教导,但他们的去名推出仍然给这种非目标内容带来小的偏差. 因此,这些模型引起的偏差恰恰提供了TailSteer想要纠正的保存错误。

blocks.en: To obtain reliable supervision, we construct two complementary trajectory types in which the resulting edit is expected to preserve part of the source image, identity editing and local editing , as illustrated in Fig. 3 . Identity editing requests no visual change and therefore provides full-image preservation supervision, whereas local editing confines the requested modification to a localized region, leaving the remaining content available for partial preservation supervision. We generate rollouts with the frozen base model and filter them using the corresponding identity or locality checks, retaining only trajectories with reliable preservation regions. For accepted edits, these regions are further converted into preservation masks, as described below.
blocks.zh: 为了获得可靠的监督,我们构建了两种互补的轨迹类型,如图所示,预期由此产生的编辑将保留部分源图像、身份编辑和当地编辑。 3. 身份编辑要求不做视觉修改,因此提供全图像保存监督,而当地编辑将所要求的修改限制在局部区域,剩下的内容可供部分保存监督使用。 我们用冷冻的基底模型进行推广,并使用相应的身份或地点检查过滤,仅保留有可靠保存区域的轨迹。 对于接受的编辑,这些区域进一步转换为保存口罩,如下所述.

blocks.en: For local editing, we further derive a binary preservation mask from the difference between the source image and the model’s generated result. The mask is not specified in advance as we do not require the generated edit to match a ground-truth target; instead, we only require the observed change in the masked regions to be sufficiently localized. Let x src x^{\mathrm{src}} denote the source state, x 1 base x_{1}^{\mathrm{base}} the endpoint of the frozen base editor’s rollout, and M M the resulting preservation mask, where M = 1 M=1 denotes regions that should remain unchanged. We construct preservation-aware target endpoint as x 1 tgt = M ⊙ x src + ( 1 − M ) ⊙ x 1 base . x_{1}^{\mathrm{tgt}}=M\odot x^{\mathrm{src}}+(1-M)\odot x_{1}^{\mathrm{base}}. (1) For identity editing, we simply set M = 1 M=1 . Thus, x 1 tgt x_{1}^{\mathrm{tgt}} restores the source content in preservation regions while retaining the edit realization produced by the base editor elsewhere.

blocks.en: For each accepted rollout, we cache the source state, selected intermediate states, the terminal state, the preservation mask, and the sampling seed for subsequent TailSteer training. Importantly, the two restricted prompt families are used only to obtain reliable preservation supervision; TailSteer itself learns a trajectory-level correction rather than an edit-specific behavior. We later show that this supervision generalizes beyond these training edits, improving multi-turn robustness for subject identity and multi-image-conditioned editing without sacrificing broader editing capabilities.
blocks.zh: 对于每个被接受的展开,我们缓存源状态,选定的中间状态,终端状态,保存面具,以及采样种子,用于接下来的TailSteeer训练. 重要的是,这两个受限的即时家庭只被用来获得可靠的保存监督;TailSteer本身学习的是轨迹级的校正,而不是编辑特定的行为. 我们后来显示,这种监督超越了这些培训编辑,提高了主题身份和多图像条件编辑的多回合强度,同时又不牺牲更广泛的编辑能力。

blocks.en: However, applying the fine-tuned model to all 50 steps reveals a different trade-off. All auxiliary components—including the frozen base model, preservation targets, masks, and velocity blending—are used only during training TailSteer, requiring no model switching, external adapters, or additional consistency mechanisms at inference. blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验细节

blocks.en: We evaluate TailSteer on four foundation models across three model families: FLUX.1 Kontext [dev] (30 steps) ( Black Forest Labs et al., 2025 ) , FLUX.2 [klein] Base 9B (50 steps) ( Black Forest Labs, 2026 ) , SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MoT (50 steps) ( Diao et al., 2026a ) , and Qwen-Image-2.1 (40 steps) ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . We collect 11,947 candidate source images from Open Images ( Kuznetsova et al., 2020 ) and MONET ( Aubin et al., 2026 ) , each paired with three independent local-edit instructions and one identity-edit instruction. Training trajectories are generated and filtered independently for each backbone. We train each model for 2,000 updates using BF16 precision and an effective batch size of 16 on eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs. We evaluate three steering onsets per backbone using the final checkpoints, with k s = 25 , 46 , 42 , 30 k_{s}=25,46,42,30 selected for qualitative comparisons on Kontext, Klein, SenseNova, and Qwen, respectively. At inference, the refined model is applied throughout the denoising trajectory under the original sampling settings. The steering onset determines where preservation-oriented steering begins during training, rather than an inference-time model switch.
blocks.zh: 我们通过四个基础模型对TailSteer进行评价,这些模型涉及三个模范家庭:FLUX.1 Kontext[dev](30步)(黑森林实验室等,2025年),FLUX.2[klein] Base 9B(50步) (黑林实验室, 2026). SenseNova-U1.5-8B-MOT(50步)(Diao等人, 2026a), Quen-Image-2.1(40步)(Quen Team, 2026). 我们收集了来自Open Images(Kuznetsova等人,2020年)和MONET(Aubin等人,2026年)的11,947张候选源图像,每张图像都配对了三个独立的本地编辑指令和一个身份编辑指令. 每个骨干都独立生成和过滤培训轨迹。 我们使用BF16精度和8台NVIDIA H100 GPU上的16有效批量尺寸来训练每个型号的2000种更新. 我们利用最后检查站评估每个主干线的三个方向点,其中Ks = 25、46、42、30k_{s 25、46、42、30,分别选作Kontext、Klein、SenseNova和Quen的质量比较。 推论,经过改进的模型在原取样设置下在整个去名轨迹中应用。 转向启动决定了在培训期间以维护为主的转向何处开始,而不是推算时间模型开关。

blocks.en: 4.2 Qualitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 定性评价

blocks.en: Figure 7: Multi-input multi-turn editing. TailSteer retains base models’ multi-image editing capabilities while substantially reducing cumulative drift, preserving backgrounds during multi-person and multi-object compositing and the girl’s dress details across successive skeleton-guided edits.
blocks.zh: 图7:多输入多回合编辑. TailSteer保留了基础模型的多图像编辑能力,同时大量减少累积漂移,在多人和多对象堆肥期间保留背景,并在连续的骨架制导编辑中保留女孩的着装细节.

blocks.en: Fig. 6 compares TailSteer with training-free MTC ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , video-data-trained VINCIE ( Qu et al., 2026 ) , and inference-time preservation modules, including FreqEdit ( Liao et al., 2026 ) , VAE-LFA ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , and Consistency LoRA V2 ( dx8152, 2026 ) . We also evaluate GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as a strong proprietary generator via direct API calls. MTC maintains scene coherence but loses source-specific details, while VINCIE exhibits severe degradation across turns. Although the preservation modules alleviate some drift, they noticeably alter the base models’ behavior and substantially degrade its single-turn editing performance, as shown in Table 2 . In contrast, TailSteer directly strengthens the base model, preserving the original tabletop color and previously established details, including the coffee cup, latte art, and cookie, even after 20 turns. Notably, TailSteer preserves the tabletop color more faithfully than GPT-Image-2.5 in this example, demonstrating that a open-weight model after TailSteer can rival or even surpass strong proprietary generators in long-horizon tasks. This advantage extends to multi-input editing (as shown in Fig. 7 ), where TailSteer retains the base models’ compositing and skeleton-guided editing capabilities while better preserving backgrounds and the girl’s dress details across pose changes.
blocks.zh: 图6 配属无培训MTC(周.等,2025年),视频数据训练的VINCIE(Qu等,2026年),以及推论时间保存模块,包括FreqEdit(Liao等,2026年),VAE-LFA(Wang等,2026年)和Consistency LoRA V2(dx8152,2026年). 我们还评价GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst(OpenAI,2026年)通过直接API调用作为强大的专有发电机. MTC保持场景的一致性,但失去了特定来源的细节,而VINCIE则表现出了跨转弯的严重退化. 虽然保存模块缓解了一些漂移现象,但如表2所示,它们明显地改变了基准模型的行为,大大降低了其单回合编辑性能。 相比之下,TailSteer直接强化了基础模型,保留了原有的台顶颜色和以前确立的细节,包括咖啡杯,拿铁艺术,以及饼干,甚至20转之后. 值得注意的是,TailSteer在此例子中比GPT-Image-2.5更忠实地保留了台顶颜色,表明TailSteer之后的开放量级模型可以在长视距任务中与强大的专有发电机竞争甚至超越. 这一优势扩大到多输入编辑(如图7所示),TailSteer保留了基本模型的堆肥和骨架制导编辑能力,同时更好地保存背景和女孩的着装细节,并作出各种变动。

blocks.en: 4.3 Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 定量评价

blocks.en: We evaluate text-to-image generation on Qwen-Image-Bench ( Li et al., 2026a ) and BizGenEval ( Li et al., 2026b ) , and single-turn editing on GEdit-Bench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , RISEBench ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , and ImgEdit-Bench ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . Table 2 shows that TailSteer largely retains pretrained capabilities across all four backbones and reported steering onsets. Text-to-image performance remains close to base model, as do GEdit and ImgEdit scores. In contrast, models with FreqEdit or ConsLoRA exhibit substantially larger declines in GEdit performance. These results support TailSteer’s ability to improve multi-turn robustness without broadly compromising the base model’s capabilities acquired through earlier training.
blocks.zh: 我们在Quen-Image-Bench(Li等人,2026a)和BizGenEval(Li等人,2026b)上评价文本到图像生成,并在Gedit-Bench(刘等人,2025年),RISE Bench(赵等人,2025年)和ImgEdit-Bench(叶等人,2025年)上进行单回合编辑. 表2显示,TailSteer基本上保留了所有四个骨干和报告的导线启动前训练能力。 文本到图像的性能仍然接近基准模型,Gedit和ImgEdit的分数也是如此. 相比之下,FreqEdit或ConsLORA的模型在Gedit的性能上显示出大幅的下降. 这些结果支持TailSteer提高多回合稳健性的能力,同时又不普遍损害通过早期培训获得的基础模型的能力。

blocks.en: While the preceding single-turn benchmarks assess the retention of pretrained generative and editing capabilities, we further evaluate their reliability across successive edits. MSE-Bench ( Qu et al., 2026 ) measures instruction following and consistency over five editing turns, while EdiVal-Bench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) employs agentic, object-centric evaluation to assess editing reliability as visual context evolves. As shown in Table 2 , TailSteer consistently improves EdiVal content consistency across all settings and achieves higher MSE-Bench success rates at selected steering onsets, although instruction-following gains remain less consistent. However, aggregate multi-turn success cannot fully distinguish inherent editing limitations from accumulated drift: for example, a failed edit in a later turn may reflect either an instruction the base model already struggles with or visual degradation inherited from earlier turns. This motivates a more controlled evaluation that directly measures cumulative visual drift alongside edit completion.
blocks.zh: 虽然先前的单回合基准评估了预先训练的基因和编辑能力的保留情况,但我们进一步评价了这些基准在连续编辑过程中的可靠性。 MSE-Bench(Qu等人,2026年)在5个编辑回合之后测量指令和一致性,而EdiVal-Bench(Chen等人,2026年)则采用代理式,以对象为中心的评价方法,随着视觉上下文的发展来评估编辑可靠性. 如表2所示,TailSteer在所有设置中不断提高EdiVal内容的一致性,并在选定的方向盘启动时实现更高的MSE-Bench成功率,尽管遵循指示的收益仍然不太一致。 然而,总的多回合成功不能将内在编辑限制与累积漂移完全区分开来:例如,在后一回合失败的编辑可能反映已经与基础模型纠缠的指令,或者从早先的转向中继承的视觉退化. 这激励了一种更具控制力的评价,在编辑完成的同时直接测量累积的视觉漂移.

blocks.en: To measure cumulative visual drift more directly, here we introduce Add & Preserve , a controlled benchmark of 100 detail-rich natural images. For each image, we randomly place a white region enclosed by a red box and apply 10 successive instructions to add or remove objects within it (Fig. 9 ). Each edited output becomes the next input, while the surrounding content should remain unchanged. We track cumulative drift outside the box using PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS against the original image, while Cumulative Object Accuracy (COA) evaluates whether the objects inside the box match the editing history. This design separately measures drift and edit completion, distinguishing genuine preservation gains from simply suppressing requested edits.
blocks.zh: 为了更直接地测量累积的视觉漂移,我们在这里引入了加和保温(Add & Preserve),这是100个细节丰富的自然图像的控制基准. 对于每个图像,我们随机地将一个白色区域置于一个红框的封面上,并应用10个连续指令来在其中添加或移除对象(图9 ). 每个编辑过的输出成为下一个输入,而周围的内容应该保持不变. 我们使用 PSNR, SSIM 和 LPIPS 对照原始图像追踪箱外的累积漂移, 而累积对象精确度(COA) 则评价箱内对象是否与编辑历史相匹配. 这种设计分别测量漂移和编辑完成,区分真正的保存收益和仅仅压制请求的编辑.

blocks.en: Despite training only on single-edit denoising rollouts, TailSteer substantially slows cumulative drift across turns (Fig. 8 ). Notably, the best preservation occurs at earlier or intermediate steering onsets rather than the latest ones, highlighting the benefit of steering before the final few steps. Table 2 confirms consistent gains across all backbones and steering onsets, with COA near base-model levels. TailSteer-Klein even surpasses GPT-Image-2.5 Sunburst on all three preservation metrics, while TailSteer-SenseNova reduces drift with nearly unchanged COA, demonstrating that TailSteer unlocks long-horizon robustness while largely retaining the base models’ generative capabilities.
blocks.zh: 尽管只进行了关于单版脱口秀的培训,但TailSteer大大减缓了跨转弯的累积漂移(图8)。 值得注意的是,最好的保存工作是在较早或中间转向开始时进行,而不是在最近进行,这突出说明了在最后几个步骤之前进行引导的好处。 表2证实所有骨干和转向架都取得了一致收益,COA接近基准模型水平。 TailSteer-Klein甚至超越了GPT-Image-2.5的Sunburst在所有三个保存度量标准上,而TailSteer-SenseNova则用几乎不变的COA来减少漂移,表明TailSteer解锁了长视线的坚固度,同时基本上保留了基模型的基因能力.

blocks.en: The turn-10 examples in Fig. 9 further illustrate TailSteer’s improved anti-drift capability, particularly for SenseNova and Klein. However, residual color shifts in VAE-based editors suggest another potential source of drift: repeated VAE reconstruction between turns. Inspired by prior work ( Joseph et al., 2024 ; Almog et al., 2025 ) , we evaluate Klein with latent feedback to bypass repeated VAE conversions between turns (note that all other experiments use standard image-feedback). In Fig. 8 , latent feedback alone offers limited improvement, but combining it with TailSteer achieves turn-10 PSNR comparable to standard feedback at turn 5, with less color distortion (Fig. 9 ), suggesting that latent reuse or improved VAE fidelity can further complement TailSteer’s trajectory-tail steering.
blocks.zh: 图9中的Tour-10例子进一步说明了TailSteer的反驱车能力提高,特别是SenseNova和Klein。 然而,基于VAE的编辑器中残留的色彩变化表明另一个潜在的漂移来源:在转弯之间反复的VAE重建. 在前作(Joseph等人,2024年;Almog等人,2025年)的启发下,我们用潜伏的反馈来评价克莱因,以绕过转弯间重复的VAE转换(注意所有其他实验都使用标准的图像反馈). 在图8中,潜在的反馈本身能提供有限的改进,但与TailSteer结合,就能在5转时实现与标准反馈相比的转-10 PSNR(图9),同时减少颜色扭曲(图9),这表明潜在的再利用或改进的VAE忠贞性可以进一步补充TailSteer的轨迹-尾导.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Cumulative drift across turns. Outside-box metrics on Add & Preserve over 10 turns. TailSteer reduces drift across all backbones, approaching or surpassing GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst in preservation. Dashed curves show further gains from bypassing inter-turn VAE for TailSteer-Klein.
blocks.zh: 图8:跨转弯的累积漂移。 添加和保存的外部框度量衡在 10 个转弯 。 尾矿减少所有骨干间的漂移,在保存中接近或超过GPT-Image-2.5-Sunburst. 绕过转弯的VAE对TailSteer-Klein有进一步的收益。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Qualitative comparison after 10 editing turns. TailSteer substantially reduces background drift while retaining the requested object edits across different backbones. For Klein, bypassing inter-turn VAE conversions further preserves the original background colors and details.
blocks.zh: 图9:10个编辑转弯后定性比较. TailSteer大幅降低背景漂移,同时保留所请求的对象在不同骨干间编辑. 对于克莱因来说,绕过回合间VAE转换进一步保留了原始背景颜色和细节.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: We compare different training strategies using the same cached preservation data on FLUX.2 [klein] Base 9B (Table 3 ). Standard SFT reduces visual drift but weakens instruction following, as illustrated by its failure to remove objects in Fig. 10 (turns 3, 6). Training only the trajectory tail achieves slightly higher PSNR but substantially degrades editing capability, while last-step-only training performs even worse under full-trajectory inference. Without on-policy training, preservation remains competitive, but spatial reasoning suffers: the model fails to arrange the cheese into the requested triangle at turn 8, consistent with its lower RISE score. In contrast, full TailSteer better preserves the cheese and cutting board at turn 6 while correctly executing the subsequent spatial rearrangement. Highlighting that preservation data alone is insufficient, retaining early dynamics and steering from on-policy states are key to retaining model’s prior with drift resistance.
blocks.zh: 我们利用FLUX.2 [Klein] Base 9B上相同的缓存保存数据来比较不同的训练策略(表3). 标准SFT减少视觉漂移,但削弱后续的指令,它未能移除图10中的对象(转弯3,6)就说明了这一点. 仅培训轨迹尾巴可达到略高的PSNR,但大大降低了编辑能力,而仅进行最后一步的培训则在全轨推论下表现更差。 没有政策培训,保存仍然具有竞争力,但空间推理受到影响:模型未能按照RISE较低的得分,在8号转弯时将奶酪排列成所要求的三角形. 相比之下,完整的TailSteer更好地保存了6转弯时的奶酪和剪切板,同时正确执行之后的空间重排. 强调仅靠保存数据是不够的,保留早期动态和来自政策状态的指导是保留模型在防漂流之前的关键。

blocks.en: We investigate how training data scale and trajectory type affect TailSteer, training each configuration for approximately one epoch (Table 4 ). At smaller scales, local-edit trajectories provide substantially stronger preservation than identity-edit trajectories, but this gap narrows as the dataset grows. Larger datasets generally improve drift resistance, while mixing both trajectory types offers a better balance between preservation and editing capability. Our main setting combines local-edit and identity-edit training data at a 3 : 1 3{:}1 ratio, highlighting the potential of scaling diverse self-generated preservation endpoints rollouts for robust multi-turn editing.
blocks.zh: 我们调查培训数据规模和轨迹类型如何影响TailSteer,培训每个配置大约一个时代(表4)。 在较小的尺度上,本地编辑的轨迹提供了比身份编辑的轨迹要强得多的保存,但随着数据集的增长,这一差距会缩小. 较大的数据集一般会提高漂流阻力,同时混合两种轨迹类型可以更好地平衡保存和编辑能力. 我们的主要设置结合了本地编辑和身份编辑培训数据,比例为 3:1 3{}1,凸显了扩大多种自生成的保存端点以进行强力多回合编辑的潜力。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented TailSteer , a final-stage training framework that unlocks the multi-turn editing potential of foundation models without relearning their existing capabilities. By concentrating preservation corrections near the denoising trajectory tail while retaining earlier dynamics, TailSteer substantially reduces cumulative drift across successive edits. Extensive experiments across FLUX, SenseNova, and Qwen demonstrate stronger long-horizon preservation while largely retaining the base models’ generative capabilities. Our findings suggest that robust multi-turn editing need not be learned anew, but can be unlocked by refining how foundation models complete each edit.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了TailSteer,这是一个最后阶段的训练框架,它释放了基础模型的多回合编辑潜力,而不重新学习其现有能力。 TailSteer把保存修正集中在去诺氏轨迹尾部附近,同时保留较早的动态,从而大大减少了连续编辑的累积漂移。 跨越FLUX、SenseNova和Quen的广泛实验显示了更强有力的长视距保护,同时在很大程度上保留了基础模型的基因能力。 我们的调查结果表明,不需要重新学习强健的多回合编辑,而可以通过完善基础模型如何完成每次编辑来解锁。
